what: Pressing a button or link with the mouse makes three short 9×2px lines burst from the pressed spot toward the upper left in a fan (−150°·−105°·−60°) — emerging from 4px at .2× scale, reaching 8px · full length at the .45 point, vanishing at 15px at .3× (420ms)

options.ease: Curve of type ‹0.2,0.8,0.3,1›, default is that
options.targets: Selector for bounce targets, default button, [role=button], a[href], summary
options.--fx-spark / --fx-spark-rim: Line color and outline color (css variable), default --kf-ink · --kf-bg

from.where: shared.js sparks (.fx-sparks) — original main chunk zx(): 9×2px line #3a372c·.75px white outline, angles −150·−105·−60, 420ms cubic-bezier(.2, .8, .3, 1), only on the 3D home page (not on the flat /hire)

note: Bounces only on mouse and pen (touch is excluded since the finger covers it). Only looks at targets inside the panel (attached element) — for the whole page, use body. One line overlay is shared by all panels
